description: Smallest useful capability sets for the request's example outcomes. Data, not a router: the existing model-router classifier reads these lines as examples (one call, no keyword fallback) and the planner adds only required producers. Never a permission.

recipes.outcome: Decide whether a new product idea is worth pursuing
recipes.note: Decision brief comes from problem definition and discovery; no PRD before the decision.

recipes.outcome: Turn an accepted feature into requirements and an engineering plan review
recipes.note: Reuses the accepted brief; a PRD never starts code edits.

recipes.outcome: Fix a known coding bug or typo
recipes.note: Investigate, fix, test, review and hand off through the existing engineering path only.
Read-only design audit, then the authorized fix, then functional QA of the changed flows (gstack.qa is not a visual review).
Public research and a recommendation; no product or code work.
The existing marketing team produces the plan, positioning included; planned pm.positioning is not added while it would only block.
